Bill.BriefDescription: Preventing cities or towns from laying off employees to then hire inmate labor.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the lay off or reduction in force of city ortown employees; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and addinga new section to chapter 35A.41 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town shall not lay off, or conduct a reduction in forceaffecting, permanent employees and fill the open positions created bythe lay off or reduction in force with inmates provided through acorrectional industries program under chapter 72.09 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town shall not lay off, or conduct a reduction in forceaffecting, permanent employees and fill the open positions created bythe lay off or reduction in force with inmates provided through acorrectional industries program under chapter 72.09 RCW.
